$Comment: The Headless Horseman on foot on the hard ride, once his hard fight throws him from the saddle: Hallows_Eve_Headless_Horseman written out again, as the game writes its own hard bosses, with more health, the hard name and his hard combat evaluator (CAE_Hallows_Eve_Headless_Horseman_HM: quicker charges and bombs, and the Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Hard_Mode effect that makes his swings and bombs hit harder). He only exists inside his hard fight, swapped in from Hallows_Eve_Headless_Horseman_Mounted_HM, and his health carries across, so MaxHealth here must equal the mounted role's. DropList Empty, since his reward is the Claims his fight pays. Any key the template does not declare makes the game refuse the whole role.
